title: Plant Based Whopper wrapper illustration
slide_intent: Differentiate a product variant within a familiar packaging family so people can identify the choice without losing brand recognition.
strategic_value: Green artwork and a green mark can distinguish the Plant Based Whopper while preserving the wrapper structure used by the wider brand.
demonstration: A folded wrapper rests on green ingredient graphics with vertical Plant Based Whopper naming and an orange cheese label; its Burger King mark is green.
practical_value: Compare which packaging elements change for the plant-based variant and which maintain the family resemblance.

content_islands.name: Green ingredient field
content_islands.spec: Use enlarged green onion, pickle and lettuce forms around the wrapped burger.

content_islands.name: Variant naming
content_islands.spec: Place vertical Plant Based Whopper labels at the sides, with a smaller cheese panel at right.

content_islands.name: Wrapped product
content_islands.spec: Center the folded wrapper with its green Burger King mark facing the viewer.

reference_purposes.Expression: Green ingredient graphics and a green mark distinguish this specimen.
reference_purposes.Application: The image shows a Plant Based Whopper packaging variant; it does not state a universal green-only rule.
